bridge.label: bridge
bridge.tip: metal decks, cables and lights over the chasm (levels 00-03)

olive.tip: 05 Gateway: olive drab checkpoint, warm khaki haze

paved.label: Paved areas
paved.tip: open floor inside these boxes is paved all over (plazas, courtyards, yards) instead of road with pavement round it

dockPits.label: Dry docks
dockPits.tip: chasm inside these is a stepped dry dock pit, not water. With any docks list set, every other chasm is harbour water (07 Shipyard)

shipDecks.label: Ship decks
shipDecks.tip: hull outlines: open floor inside is a warship deck with its hull side below, walls on it are the ship's superstructure. Move a hull's collision shapes and its outline together (07 Shipyard)

gangways.label: Gangways
gangways.tip: open floor inside these is a steel gangway or gantry, with handrails and a shadow on the water (07 Shipyard)

containers.label: Container stacks
containers.tip: walls inside these are shipping container stacks with corrugated tops (07 Shipyard)
